# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives

## Overview

Build a bold, modern landing page for **CreativeHub**, an online learning platform for creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists. The page should feel energetic and inspiring — like stepping into a vibrant creative studio. The goal is simple: get visitors excited about the platform and drive them to start a free trial.

## Vibe & Visual Direction

Think **Skillshare meets Dribbble** — playful yet polished. Use a vibrant color palette anchored by a deep navy or charcoal background in the hero with pops of coral/orange, electric green, or warm yellow as accent colors. Typography should be bold and contemporary — a chunky geometric sans-serif for headlines (like Plus Jakarta Sans or similar) paired with a clean body font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, and subtle hover animations will reinforce the modern, approachable feel.

## Key Priorities

- **Hero conversion flow**: The hero is the most critical section. It needs to immediately communicate the value prop and present two clear sign-up paths (Google and email). Make these CTAs impossible to miss. The category pills beneath should feel browsable and inviting.

- **Course category tabs**: The tabbed course grid is the core interactive experience. Switching between categories (Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, etc.) should feel instant and smooth. Each course card needs a thumbnail, title, instructor name, student count, and duration — make them visually rich.

- **Teacher carousel**: The horizontal scrolling teacher section should feel tactile and explorable, with clear navigation affordances (arrows or scroll indicators).

- **FAQ accordion**: Clean expand/collapse behavior — only one item open at a time feels best here.

- **Stats section**: The platform numbers (425k+ members, 30k+ classes, etc.) should land with visual impact — large type, maybe a contrasting background band.

## Note

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, data content, and interaction specs. The page is responsive, light mode only.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

{"type": "text", "text": "Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/web-design-expert

# Web Design Expert

Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.

## When to Use This Skill

**Use for:**
- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
- Color palette creation and rationale
- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
- Component visual design (not just code)
- Responsive design strategy
- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements

**Do NOT use for:**
- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**

## Core Design Process

### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)

```
BUSINESS CONTEXT:
- What is the primary goal?
- Who is the target audience?
- What action should users take?
- Who are competitors?

BRAND PERSONALITY:
- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
```

### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)

Each concept includes:
- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)

## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard

**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**

OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)

```css
/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
```

**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
| Resource | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |

**When presenting color palettes:**
```
Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
```

Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.

### 3. Design Principles

**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?

**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?

## Common Anti-Patterns

### Design by Committee
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |

### Decoration Over Function
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |

### Ignoring the Fold
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |

### Low Contrast Text
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |

### Mobile as Afterthought
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |

## Design Trend Evolution

| Era | Trend |
|-----|-------|
| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |

**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
- Flat design without depth
- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
- Desktop hamburger menus

## Output Deliverables

1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets

## MCP Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `21st_magic_component_inspiration` | Search UI patterns for inspiration |
| `21st_magic_component_builder` | Generate React/Tailwind components |
| `21st_magic_component_refiner` | Improve existing component UI |
| `logo_search` | Get company logos in JSX/TSX/SVG |

## Integration with Other Skills

Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:

| Skill | Path | Use For |
|-------|------|---------|
| **typography-expert** | `typography-expert/SKILL.md` | Deep typography decisions, font pairing, OpenType features |
| **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert** | `color-theory-palette-harmony-expert/SKILL.md` | Color science, palette harmony, perceptual color spaces |
| **design-system-creator** | `design-system-creator/SKILL.md` | Design tokens, CSS architecture, component libraries |
| **vibe-matcher** | `vibe-matcher/SKILL.md` | Translating emotional vibes to visual DNA |
| **design-archivist** | `design-archivist/SKILL.md` | Building visual databases, competitive research |

## Reference Files

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `references/layout-systems.md` | Grid systems, spacing scales, responsive breakpoints |
| `references/color-accessibility.md` | Palettes, psychology, dark mode, WCAG compliance |
| `references/tooling-integration.md` | 21st.dev, Figma MCP, component workflows |

---

*The best design is invisible until you notice its excellence.*
"}

{
  "application": "web-design",
  "case_id": "case-education-landing-creativehub",
  "language": "en",
  "site": {
    "type": "e-commerce",
    "page_count": 1,
    "audience": "creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists seeking online learning",
    "tone": "modern, playful, bold",
    "responsive": true,
    "dark_mode": false
  },
  "brief": {
    "title": "CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives",
    "one_liner": "An online learning community offering thousands of creative classes taught by industry professionals, from illustration and design to photography and filmmaking.",
    "goal": "Drive free trial sign-ups and showcase the breadth of creative courses, expert teachers, and community features to convert visitors into paying members."
  },
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_id": "home",
      "file": "index.html",
      "sections": [
        "hero",
        "features",
        "stats",
        "courses",

        "teachers",
        "testimonials",
        "teams",
        "faq",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Serve as the primary landing page to introduce the platform, highlight course offerings, showcase expert teachers, display social proof, and drive free trial sign-ups."
    }
  ],
  "navigation": [
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Browse link in header",
      "to": "home"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Sign In link in header",
      "to": "home"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Sign Up button in header",
      "to": "home"
    }
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {
      "id": "faq-accordion",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "User clicks on a FAQ question row",
      "expected": "The answer expands below the question; clicking again collapses it",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "course-category-tabs",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "User clicks on a category tab (e.g., Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, Marketing, Animation, etc.)",

      "type": "state-change"

    {

    {

      "trigger": "User clicks Continue with email button in hero",

      "type": "input"

    {

        "30k+",

        "Landscapes: A Free-Flow Watercolour Masterclass",

        "How to Draw: A Beginner's Guide",
        "Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners"

      "description": "Grid of featured online courses with thumbnails, student counts, duration, and instructor names"

        "Graphic Design",

        "Animation",
        "Film & Video",
        "Freelance",
        "UI/UX Design"

      "description": "Horizontal scrolling category pills in the hero section linking to different course topics"

    {
      "id": "expert-teachers",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Expert Teachers",
      "expected_content": [
        "Illustrator",
        "Digital Designer",
        "Animator, Product Designer",
        "Graphic Designer",
        "Watercolor Artist",
        "Motion Graphics Artist"
      ],
      "description": "Grid of featured teachers with photos, names, and their creative specialties"
    },
    {
      "id": "faq-items",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## FAQ",
      "expected_content": [
        "What is CreativeHub?",
        "What is included in my membership?",
        "What can I learn?",
        "What happens after my trial is over?",
        "Can I teach on the platform?"
      ],
      "description": "Accordion-style frequently asked questions with expandable answers"
    },
    {
      "id": "testimonials-list",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Student Testimonials",
      "expected_content": [
        "the best learning decision I've ever made",
        "Real-world skills without the financial burden",
        "one subscription I can't imagine not having",
        "helps me level up my skills"
      ],
      "description": "Student testimonial quotes displayed in a grid with student names and avatars"
    }
  ]
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --hero-bg:           oklch(12% 0.025 264);
      --white:             oklch(99% 0.005 264);
      --accent-green:      oklch(82% 0.175 155);
      --accent-purple:     oklch(42% 0.255 290);
      --accent-purple-dim: oklch(92% 0.06 290);
      --text-primary:      oklch(14% 0.02 264);
      --text-secondary:    oklch(45% 0.015 264);
      --text-muted:        oklch(60% 0.01 264);
      --bg-light:          oklch(98% 0.005 264);
      --bg-gray:           oklch(95% 0.008 264);
      --border:            oklch(90% 0.01 264);
      --shadow-card:       0 2px 16px oklch(14% 0.02 264 / 0.07);
      --shadow-hover:      0 10px 36px oklch(14% 0.02 264 / 0.14);
      --font:              'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
      --r-sm:  6px;
      --r-md:  12px;
      --r-lg:  20px;
      --r-xl:  28px;
      --r-full: 9999px;
      --max-w: 1200px;
      --px:    1.5rem;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    .container { max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--px); }

    /* ── NAV ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .nav {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.95);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    .nav-inner {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      height: 68px; gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .nav-logo {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      text-decoration: none; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem;
      color: var(--text-primary); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .nav-logo-mark {
      width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--accent-purple);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .nav-logo-mark svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; list-style: none; }
    .nav-links a {
      text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .nav-mobile-toggle {
      display: none; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer;
      width: 40px; height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border-radius: var(--r-md); transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-mobile-toggle:hover { background: var(--bg-gray); }

    /* ── BUTTONS ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem;
      cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; text-decoration: none;
      border: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1;
    }
    .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-gray); }
    .btn-primary { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--white); }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(24% 0.02 264); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-green { background: var(--accent-green); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-green:hover { background: oklch(76% 0.175 155); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(82% 0.175 155 / 0.4); }
    .btn-white { background: var(--white); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-white:hover { background: oklch(96% 0.005 264); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-outline-white { background: transparent; border-color: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.4); color: var(--white); }
    .btn-outline-white:hover { border-color: var(--white); background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.08); }
    .btn-outline-purple { background: transparent; border-color: var(--white); color: var(--white); }
    .btn-outline-purple:hover { background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.12); }
    .btn-lg { padding: 0.9rem 2rem; font-size: 1rem; }
    .btn-full { width: 100%; }

    /* ── HERO ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      background: var(--hero-bg);
      padding: 5rem 0 4rem;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-glow {
      position: absolute; top: -160px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 900px; height: 600px; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.22) 0%, transparent 65%);
    }
    .hero-glow-2 {
      position: absolute; bottom: -100px; right: -100px;
      width: 500px; height: 400px; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, oklch(82% 0.175 155 / 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
      background: oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.18);
      border: 1px solid oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.35);
      color: oklch(80% 0.12 290); padding: 0.35rem 0.875rem;
      border-radius: var(--r-full); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .hero-badge span { color: var(--accent-green); }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 800; color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem;
    }
    .hero-title .hl { color: var(--accent-green); }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.2rem; color: oklch(68% 0.018 264);
      margin-bottom: 2.25rem; font-weight: 500;
    }
    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem; max-width: 380px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem;
    }
    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 0.7rem; color: oklch(50% 0.012 264);
      max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem; line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .hero-legal a { color: oklch(65% 0.015 264); text-decoration: underline; }
    .hero-cat-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(55% 0.015 264);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .hero-pills {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 var(--px); max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .pill {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.07);
      border: 1px solid oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.14);
      color: oklch(78% 0.014 264); border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none;
    }
    .pill:hover {
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.14);
      color: var(--white); border-color: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.28);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ── SECTION HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .section-label {
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-purple); margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.2vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.12;
    }
    .section-sub {
      font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-top: 0.75rem; max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ── FEATURES ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .features { padding: 5rem 0; background: var(--white); }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem; margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .feature-card {
      padding: 1.75rem; border-radius: var(--r-xl);
      background: var(--bg-light); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.25);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
      background: var(--accent-purple-dim);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 1.6rem;
    }
    .feature-card h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .feature-card p { font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.62; }

    /* ── STATS ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .stats {
      background: var(--accent-green); padding: 4.5rem 0;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem; text-align: center;
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4.5vw, 3.75rem); font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 1;
      color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(28% 0.02 155); }

    /* ── COURSES ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .courses { padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--bg-light); }
    .courses-tabs {
      display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 0; scrollbar-width: none;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); margin: 2rem 0 2.5rem;
    }
    .courses-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .tab-btn {
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border: none; background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s; position: relative; bottom: -2px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent-purple); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-purple); }
    .courses-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem; min-height: 300px;
    }
    .course-card {
      background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
      overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: all 0.25s; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
    .course-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; width: 100%; position: relative;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 2.8rem;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .course-thumb-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;

    .course-card:hover .course-thumb-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .play-btn {

    }
    .play-btn svg { margin-left: 3px; }
    .course-body { padding: 1rem; }
    .course-title {
      font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4;

    .empty-tab p { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* ── CREATIVE FEED ───────────────────────────────────── */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--hero-bg);
    }
    .creative-feed .section-label { color: var(--accent-green); }
    .creative-feed .section-title { color: var(--white); }
    .creative-feed .section-sub { color: oklch(62% 0.015 264); max-width: 480px; }
    .feed-grid {

  const tabs = [
    "Featured","Music","Drawing & Painting","Marketing","Animation",

    "Photography","Productivity"

  const teachers = [
    { name: "Lisa Bardot",    spec: "Illustrator",                  init: "LB", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(68% 0.22 350), oklch(52% 0.26 310))" },
    { name: "Daniel Scott",   spec: "Digital Designer",             init: "DS", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(52% 0.24 258), oklch(44% 0.26 290))" },

    { name: "Emonee LaRussa", spec: "Motion Graphics Artist",       init: "EL", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(60% 0.22 318), oklch(50% 0.26 292))" },

      btn.className = 'tab-btn' + (t === activeTab ? ' active' : '');
      btn.textContent = t;
      btn.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', t === activeTab);
      btn.onclick = () => setTab(t);
      container.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  function setTab(tab) {
    activeTab = tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
      const active = b.textContent === tab;
      b.classList.toggle('active', active);
      b.setAttribute('aria-selected', active);
    });
    renderCourses();
  }

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');

  function buildTeachers() {
    const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');

          <div class="teacher-spec">${t.spec}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function scrollCarousel(dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
    track.scrollBy({ left: dir * 260, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  /* ── RENDER FAQ ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildFaq() {
    const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
    list.innerHTML = faqs.map((f, i) => `
      <div class="faq-item" id="faq-${i}">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(${i})" role="button" tabindex="0" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' ')toggleFaq(${i})">

          <span class="faq-chevron">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="faq-a" id="faq-a-${i}">
          <div class="faq-a-inner">${f.a}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function toggleFaq(idx) {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      if (i === idx) {
        item.classList.toggle('open');
      } else {
        item.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── MODAL ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function openModal(type) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
    const googleBtn = document.getElementById('googleBtn');
    const title = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
    const sub = document.getElementById('modalSub');

    if (type === 'google') {
      title.textContent = 'Continue with Google';
      sub.textContent = 'We\'ll open Google sign-in to create your account.';
      googleBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal(); showToast('✓ Google OAuth would initiate here'); };
    } else {
      title.textContent = 'Start your free trial';
      sub.textContent = 'Get 7 days free. No credit card required.';
      googleBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal(); showToast('✓ Google OAuth would initiate here'); };
    }

    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    if (type === 'email') {
      setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('emailInput').focus(), 350);
    }
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function handleOverlayClick(e) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal();
  }

  function handleFormSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value;
    closeModal();
    showToast(`✓ Welcome! Check ${email} for your sign-in link`);
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
  });

  /* ── TOAST ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
  }

  /* ── INIT ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  buildTabs();
  renderCourses();
  buildTeachers();
  buildFaq();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    }
    .nav-logo-mark {
      width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--accent-purple);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .nav-logo-mark svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; list-style: none; }
    .nav-links a {
      text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .nav-mobile-toggle {
      display: none; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer;
      width: 40px; height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border-radius: var(--r-md); transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-mobile-toggle:hover { background: var(--bg-gray); }

    /* ── BUTTONS ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem;
      cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; text-decoration: none;
      border: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1;
    }
    .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-gray); }
    .btn-primary { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--white); }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(24% 0.02 264); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-green { background: var(--accent-green); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-green:hover { background: oklch(76% 0.175 155); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(82% 0.175 155 / 0.4); }
    .btn-white { background: var(--white); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-white:hover { background: oklch(96% 0.005 264); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-outline-white { background: transparent; border-color: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.4); color: var(--white); }
    .btn-outline-white:hover { border-color: var(--white); background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.08); }
    .btn-outline-purple { background: transparent; border-color: var(--white); color: var(--white); }
    .btn-outline-purple:hover { background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.12); }
    .btn-lg { padding: 0.9rem 2rem; font-size: 1rem; }
    .btn-full { width: 100%; }

    /* ── HERO ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      background: var(--hero-bg);
      padding: 5rem 0 4rem;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-glow {
      position: absolute; top: -160px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 900px; height: 600px; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.22) 0%, transparent 65%);
    }
    .hero-glow-2 {
      position: absolute; bottom: -100px; right: -100px;
      width: 500px; height: 400px; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, oklch(82% 0.175 155 / 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
      background: oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.18);
      border: 1px solid oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.35);
      color: oklch(80% 0.12 290); padding: 0.35rem 0.875rem;
      border-radius: var(--r-full); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .hero-badge span { color: var(--accent-green); }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 800; color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem;
    }
    .hero-title .hl { color: var(--accent-green); }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.2rem; color: oklch(68% 0.018 264);
      margin-bottom: 2.25rem; font-weight: 500;
    }
    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem; max-width: 380px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem;
    }
    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 0.7rem; color: oklch(50% 0.012 264);
      max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem; line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .hero-legal a { color: oklch(65% 0.015 264); text-decoration: underline; }
    .hero-cat-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(55% 0.015 264);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .hero-pills {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 var(--px); max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .pill {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.07);
      border: 1px solid oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.14);
      color: oklch(78% 0.014 264); border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none;
    }
    .pill:hover {
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.14);
      color: var(--white); border-color: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.28);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ── SECTION HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .section-label {
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-purple); margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.2vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.12;
    }
    .section-sub {
      font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-top: 0.75rem; max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ── FEATURES ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .features { padding: 5rem 0; background: var(--white); }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem; margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .feature-card {
      padding: 1.75rem; border-radius: var(--r-xl);
      background: var(--bg-light); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.25);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
      background: var(--accent-purple-dim);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 1.6rem;
    }
    .feature-card h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .feature-card p { font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.62; }

    /* ── STATS ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .stats {
      background: var(--accent-green); padding: 4.5rem 0;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem; text-align: center;
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4.5vw, 3.75rem); font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 1;
      color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(28% 0.02 155); }

    /* ── COURSES ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .courses { padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--bg-light); }
    .courses-tabs {
      display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 0; scrollbar-width: none;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); margin: 2rem 0 2.5rem;
    }
    .courses-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .tab-btn {
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border: none; background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s; position: relative; bottom: -2px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent-purple); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-purple); }
    .courses-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem; min-height: 300px;
    }
    .course-card {
      background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
      overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: all 0.25s; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
    .course-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; width: 100%; position: relative;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 2.8rem;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .course-thumb-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.18);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.22s;
    }
    .course-card:hover .course-thumb-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .play-btn {
      width: 48px; height: 48px; background: var(--white); border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3);
    }
    .play-btn svg { margin-left: 3px; }
    .course-body { padding: 1rem; }
    .course-title {
      font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
      display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .course-instructor { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .course-meta { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .course-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }
    .empty-tab {
      grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 4rem 0;
    }
    .empty-tab .empty-icon { font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: block; }
    .empty-tab h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .empty-tab p { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* ── CREATIVE FEED ───────────────────────────────────── */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--hero-bg);
    }
    .creative-feed .section-label { color: var(--accent-green); }
    .creative-feed .section-title { color: var(--white); }
    .creative-feed .section-sub { color: oklch(62% 0.015 264); max-width: 480px; }
    .feed-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem; margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .feed-card {
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.05);
      border: 1px solid oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.1);
      border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 2.25rem 2rem;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .feed-card:hover {
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.085);
      border-color: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.2); transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .feed-icon {
      width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
    }
    .feed-card h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .feed-card p { font-size: 0.88rem; color: oklch(62% 0.015 264); line-height: 1.68; }

    /* ── TEACHERS ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .teachers { padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--white); }
    .teachers-hd {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .carousel-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--border); background: var(--white);
      cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      transition: all 0.2s; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 1.1rem;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-purple); color: var(--accent-purple); background: var(--accent-purple-dim); }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .teacher-card {
      flex: 0 0 215px; scroll-snap-align: start;
      border-radius: var(--r-lg); overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg-light); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.25s; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
      border-color: oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.3);
    }
    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
    }
    .teacher-info { padding: 1rem 1rem 1.1rem; }
    .teacher-name { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
    .teacher-spec { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4; }

    /* ── TESTIMONIALS ────────────────────────────────────── */
    .testimonials { padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--bg-gray); }
    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem; margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .t-card {
      background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl);
      padding: 2.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      position: relative; transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .t-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
    .t-quote-mark {
      position: absolute; top: 1.25rem; right: 1.5rem;
      font-size: 4rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--accent-green);
      font-weight: 800; opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .t-text {
      font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.72; color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font-style: italic;
    }
    .t-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
    .t-avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--white); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .t-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .t-role { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* ── TEAMS ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .teams {
      padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--accent-purple); text-align: center;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .teams-glow {
      position: absolute; top: -150px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 700px; height: 500px; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, oklch(65% 0.2 290 / 0.2) 0%, transparent 65%);
    }
    .teams-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .teams .section-label { color: oklch(78% 0.1 290); }
    .teams .section-title { color: var(--white); max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .teams-body {
      color: oklch(80% 0.08 290); max-width: 600px;
      margin: 1rem auto 2.5rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.72;
    }
    .teams-logos {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      gap: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .team-logo-pill {
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.1); border: 1px solid oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.2);
      padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(82% 0.06 290);
    }

    /* ── FAQ ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .faq { padding: 5.5rem 0; background: var(--white); }
    .faq-layout {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 4rem; margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .faq-aside {}
    .faq-aside .section-sub { margin-top: 0.75rem; }
    .faq-cta { margin-top: 2rem; }
    .faq-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .faq-item {
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .faq-item.open { border-color: oklch(42% 0.255 290 / 0.3); }
    .faq-q {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 1.1rem 1.4rem; cursor: pointer; gap: 1rem; user-select: none;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .faq-q:hover { background: var(--bg-light); }
    .faq-q h3 { font-size: 0.94rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; }
    .faq-chevron {
      width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-gray); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0; transition: all 0.3s; color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-chevron {
      background: var(--accent-purple); color: var(--white); transform: rotate(180deg);
    }
    .faq-a { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 0.35s ease; }
    .faq-item.open .faq-a { max-height: 300px; }
    .faq-a-inner {
      padding: 0 1.4rem 1.1rem; font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.72;
    }

    /* ── FOOTER ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer { background: var(--hero-bg); padding: 4.5rem 0 2.5rem; }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.6fr repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 2.5rem; padding-bottom: 3rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.1);
    }
    .footer-logo { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .footer-brand p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: oklch(50% 0.012 264); line-height: 1.62; max-width: 240px; }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(58% 0.012 264); margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55rem; }
    .footer-col ul li a {
      text-decoration: none; color: oklch(50% 0.012 264);
      font-size: 0.85rem; transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between;
      padding-top: 1.5rem; gap: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .footer-legal { font-size: 0.72rem; color: oklch(42% 0.01 264); line-height: 1.62; max-width: 640px; }
    .footer-copy { font-size: 0.72rem; color: oklch(42% 0.01 264); white-space: nowrap; }

    /* ── MODAL ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.55);
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px); z-index: 300;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem;
      opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }
    .modal-overlay.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
    .modal {
      background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 2.5rem;
      max-width: 440px; width: 100%; position: relative;
      transform: translateY(24px); transition: transform 0.3s;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3);
    }
    .modal-overlay.active .modal { transform: translateY(0); }
    .modal-close {
      position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem;
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; border: none;
      background: var(--bg-gray); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--border); }
    .modal-logo { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .modal h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }
    .modal .modal-sub { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
    .modal-google-btn {
      width: 100%; padding: 0.85rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--r-full);
      border: 2px solid var(--border); background: var(--white);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem;
      font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .modal-google-btn:hover { border-color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); }
    .modal-divider {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .modal-divider hr { flex: 1; border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .modal-divider span { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
    .form-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .form-group label { display: block; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .form-group input {
      width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--r-md); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.9rem;
      transition: border-color 0.2s; outline: none; background: var(--white);
    }

    .modal-legal { font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 1rem; }

      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(32% 0.18 260), oklch(42% 0.22 285))", emoji: "🎬"
    },
    {
      title: "iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone",
      instructor: "Sean Dalton", students: "13,423", duration: "1h 34m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Photography"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(62% 0.17 195), oklch(70% 0.19 160))", emoji: "📸"
    }
  ];

  const tabs = [
    "Featured","Music","Drawing & Painting","Marketing","Animation",
    "Social Media","UI/UX Design","Creative Writing","Digital Illustration",
    "Film & Video","Crafts","Freelance & Entrepreneurship","Graphic Design",
    "Photography","Productivity"
  ];

  const teachers = [
    { name: "Lisa Bardot",    spec: "Illustrator",                  init: "LB", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(68% 0.22 350), oklch(52% 0.26 310))" },
    { name: "Daniel Scott",   spec: "Digital Designer",             init: "DS", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(52% 0.24 258), oklch(44% 0.26 290))" },
    { name: "Derek Elliot",   spec: "Animator, Product Designer",   init: "DE", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(76% 0.20 55), oklch(70% 0.22 32))" },
    { name: "Aaron Draplin",  spec: "Graphic Designer",             init: "AD", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(64% 0.22 28), oklch(58% 0.26 12))" },
    { name: "Zaneena Nabeel", spec: "Watercolor Artist",            init: "ZN", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(65% 0.17 198), oklch(60% 0.19 215))" },
    { name: "Emonee LaRussa", spec: "Motion Graphics Artist",       init: "EL", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(60% 0.22 318), oklch(50% 0.26 292))" },
    { name: "Brent Eviston",  spec: "Master Artist",                init: "BE", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(74% 0.17 155), oklch(62% 0.18 175))" },
    { name: "Jordy Vandeput", spec: "Filmmaker and YouTuber",       init: "JV", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(33% 0.16 258), oklch(28% 0.13 278))" }
  ];

  const faqs = [
    {
      q: "What is CreativeHub?",
      a: "CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey."
    },
    {
      q: "What is included in my membership?",
      a: "As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more."
    },
    {
      q: "What can I learn?",
      a: "CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub."
    },
    {
      q: "What happens after my trial is over?",
      a: "After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round."
    },
    {
      q: "Can I teach on the platform?",
      a: "Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more about becoming a teacher."
    }
  ];

  /* ── RENDER COURSES ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  let activeTab = "Featured";

  function buildTabs() {
    const container = document.getElementById('courseTabs');
    tabs.forEach(t => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'tab-btn' + (t === activeTab ? ' active' : '');
      btn.textContent = t;
      btn.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', t === activeTab);
      btn.onclick = () => setTab(t);
      container.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  function setTab(tab) {
    activeTab = tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
      const active = b.textContent === tab;
      b.classList.toggle('active', active);
      b.setAttribute('aria-selected', active);
    });
    renderCourses();
  }

  function renderCourses() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('coursesGrid');
    const filtered = courses.filter(c => c.cats.includes(activeTab));

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      grid.innerHTML = `
        <div class="empty-tab">
          <span class="empty-icon">🎒</span>
          <h3>More ${activeTab} classes coming soon!</h3>
          <p>We're always adding new courses. Check out Featured in the meantime.</p>
        </div>`;
      return;
    }

    grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => `
      <div class="course-card" onclick="showToast('Opening: ${c.title.substring(0,40)}…')">
        <div class="course-thumb" style="background: ${c.grad}">
          <span style="filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.4))">${c.emoji}</span>
          <div class="course-thumb-overlay">
            <div class="play-btn">
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="oklch(42% 0.255 290)"><polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/></svg>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="course-body">
          <div class="course-title">${c.title}</div>
          <div class="course-instructor">by ${c.instructor}</div>
          <div class="course-meta">
            <span>
              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>
              ${c.students}
            </span>
            <span>
              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
              ${c.duration}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  /* ── RENDER TEACHERS ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildTeachers() {
    const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
    track.innerHTML = teachers.map(t => `
      <div class="teacher-card" onclick="showToast('Viewing ${t.name}'s profile')">
        <div class="teacher-avatar" style="background: ${t.grad}">${t.init}</div>
        <div class="teacher-info">
          <div class="teacher-name">${t.name}</div>
          <div class="teacher-spec">${t.spec}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function scrollCarousel(dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
    track.scrollBy({ left: dir * 260, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  /* ── RENDER FAQ ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildFaq() {
    const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
    list.innerHTML = faqs.map((f, i) => `
      <div class="faq-item" id="faq-${i}">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(${i})" role="button" tabindex="0" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' ')toggleFaq(${i})">
          <h3>${f.q}</h3>
          <span class="faq-chevron">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="faq-a" id="faq-a-${i}">
          <div class="faq-a-inner">${f.a}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function toggleFaq(idx) {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      if (i === idx) {
        item.classList.toggle('open');
      } else {
        item.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── MODAL ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function openModal(type) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
    const googleBtn = document.getElementById('googleBtn');
    const title = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
    const sub = document.getElementById('modalSub');

    if (type === 'google') {
      title.textContent = 'Continue with Google';
      sub.textContent = 'We\'ll open Google sign-in to create your account.';
      googleBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal(); showToast('✓ Google OAuth would initiate here'); };
    } else {
      title.textContent = 'Start your free trial';
      sub.textContent = 'Get 7 days free. No credit card required.';
      googleBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal(); showToast('✓ Google OAuth would initiate here'); };
    }

    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    if (type === 'email') {
      setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('emailInput').focus(), 350);
    }
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function handleOverlayClick(e) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal();
  }

  function handleFormSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value;
    closeModal();
    showToast(`✓ Welcome! Check ${email} for your sign-in link`);
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
  });

  /* ── TOAST ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
  }

  /* ── INIT ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  buildTabs();
  renderCourses();
  buildTeachers();
  buildFaq();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --hero-bg:           oklch(12% 0.025 264);
      --white:             oklch(99% 0.005 264);
      --accent-green:      oklch(82% 0.175 155);
      --accent-purple:     oklch(42% 0.255 290);
      --accent-purple-dim: oklch(92% 0.06 290);
      --text-primary:      oklch(14% 0.02 264);
      --text-secondary:    oklch(45% 0.015 264);

    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--white);

    }

    .container { max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--px); }

    /* ── NAV ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .nav {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: oklch(99% 0.005 264 / 0.95);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    .nav-inner {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      height: 68px; gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .nav-logo {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      text-decoration: none; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem;
      color: var(--text-primary); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .nav-logo-mark {
      width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px;

    .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; list-style: none; }

      text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-secondary);

    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .nav-mobile-toggle {
      display: none; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer;

      border-radius: var(--r-md); transition: background 0.2s;

    .nav-mobile-toggle:hover { background: var(--bg-gray); }

    /* ── BUTTONS ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;

    .btn-white { background: var(--white); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .btn-white:hover { background: oklch(96% 0.005 264); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── HERO ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;

    .hero-title .hl { color: var(--accent-green); }

<!-- ═══════════════════════ TOAST ════════════════════════════ -->
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
  /* ── DATA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const courses = [
    {
      title: "Kickstart your Creativity with Procreate: 20 Fun Drawings for Beginners and Beyond",
      instructor: "Lisa Bardot", students: "24,872", duration: "6h 24m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Digital Illustration"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(68% 0.22 350), oklch(52% 0.26 295))", emoji: "🎨"
    },
    {
      title: "Social Media Content Creation in Canva: From Beginner to Advanced",
      instructor: "Maggie Stara", students: "44,495", duration: "13h 19m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Social Media", "Marketing"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(84% 0.20 75), oklch(72% 0.22 40))", emoji: "📱"
    },
    {
      title: "Landscapes: A Free-Flow Watercolour Masterclass",
      instructor: "Jane Davies", students: "2,579", duration: "1h 42m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Drawing & Painting"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(68% 0.16 215), oklch(62% 0.18 178))", emoji: "🌊"
    },
    {
      title: "Figma UI UX Design Advanced: Become a Pro",
      instructor: "Daniel Scott", students: "6,692", duration: "8h 48m",
      cats: ["Featured", "UI/UX Design"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(55% 0.26 290), oklch(48% 0.22 260))", emoji: "🎯"
    },
    {
      title: "ChatGPT for Creatives: AI-Powered SEO, Marketing, & Productivity",
      instructor: "Peggy Dean", students: "18,842", duration: "1h 18m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Marketing", "Productivity"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(74% 0.17 155), oklch(63% 0.18 175))", emoji: "🤖"
    },
    {
      title: "How to Draw: A Beginner's Guide",
      instructor: "Brent Eviston", students: "26,243", duration: "5h 57m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Drawing & Painting"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(78% 0.20 55), oklch(68% 0.22 32))", emoji: "✏️"
    },
    {
      title: "Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners",
      instructor: "Jordy Vandeput", students: "17,887", duration: "3h 44m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Film & Video"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(32% 0.18 260), oklch(42% 0.22 285))", emoji: "🎬"
    },
    {
      title: "iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone",
      instructor: "Sean Dalton", students: "13,423", duration: "1h 34m",
      cats: ["Featured", "Photography"],
      grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(62% 0.17 195), oklch(70% 0.19 160))", emoji: "📸"
    }
  ];

  const tabs = [
    "Featured","Music","Drawing & Painting","Marketing","Animation",
    "Social Media","UI/UX Design","Creative Writing","Digital Illustration",
    "Film & Video","Crafts","Freelance & Entrepreneurship","Graphic Design",
    "Photography","Productivity"
  ];

  const teachers = [
    { name: "Lisa Bardot",    spec: "Illustrator",                  init: "LB", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(68% 0.22 350), oklch(52% 0.26 310))" },
    { name: "Daniel Scott",   spec: "Digital Designer",             init: "DS", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(52% 0.24 258), oklch(44% 0.26 290))" },
    { name: "Derek Elliot",   spec: "Animator, Product Designer",   init: "DE", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(76% 0.20 55), oklch(70% 0.22 32))" },
    { name: "Aaron Draplin",  spec: "Graphic Designer",             init: "AD", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(64% 0.22 28), oklch(58% 0.26 12))" },
    { name: "Zaneena Nabeel", spec: "Watercolor Artist",            init: "ZN", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(65% 0.17 198), oklch(60% 0.19 215))" },
    { name: "Emonee LaRussa", spec: "Motion Graphics Artist",       init: "EL", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(60% 0.22 318), oklch(50% 0.26 292))" },
    { name: "Brent Eviston",  spec: "Master Artist",                init: "BE", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(74% 0.17 155), oklch(62% 0.18 175))" },
    { name: "Jordy Vandeput", spec: "Filmmaker and YouTuber",       init: "JV", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(33% 0.16 258), oklch(28% 0.13 278))" }
  ];

  const faqs = [
    {
      q: "What is CreativeHub?",
      a: "CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey."
    },
    {
      q: "What is included in my membership?",
      a: "As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more."
    },
    {
      q: "What can I learn?",
      a: "CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub."
    },
    {
      q: "What happens after my trial is over?",
      a: "After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round."
    },
    {
      q: "Can I teach on the platform?",
      a: "Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more about becoming a teacher."
    }
  ];

  /* ── RENDER COURSES ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  let activeTab = "Featured";

  function buildTabs() {
    const container = document.getElementById('courseTabs');
    tabs.forEach(t => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'tab-btn' + (t === activeTab ? ' active' : '');
      btn.textContent = t;
      btn.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', t === activeTab);
      btn.onclick = () => setTab(t);
      container.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  function setTab(tab) {
    activeTab = tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
      const active = b.textContent === tab;
      b.classList.toggle('active', active);
      b.setAttribute('aria-selected', active);
    });
    renderCourses();
  }

  function renderCourses() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('coursesGrid');
    const filtered = courses.filter(c => c.cats.includes(activeTab));

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      grid.innerHTML = `
        <div class="empty-tab">
          <span class="empty-icon">🎒</span>
          <h3>More ${activeTab} classes coming soon!</h3>
          <p>We're always adding new courses. Check out Featured in the meantime.</p>
        </div>`;
      return;
    }

    grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => `
      <div class="course-card" onclick="showToast('Opening: ${c.title.substring(0,40)}…')">
        <div class="course-thumb" style="background: ${c.grad}">
          <span style="filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.4))">${c.emoji}</span>
          <div class="course-thumb-overlay">
            <div class="play-btn">
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="oklch(42% 0.255 290)"><polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/></svg>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="course-body">
          <div class="course-title">${c.title}</div>
          <div class="course-instructor">by ${c.instructor}</div>
          <div class="course-meta">
            <span>
              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>
              ${c.students}
            </span>
            <span>
              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
              ${c.duration}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  /* ── RENDER TEACHERS ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildTeachers() {
    const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
    track.innerHTML = teachers.map(t => `
      <div class="teacher-card" onclick="showToast('Viewing ${t.name}'s profile')">
        <div class="teacher-avatar" style="background: ${t.grad}">${t.init}</div>
        <div class="teacher-info">
          <div class="teacher-name">${t.name}</div>
          <div class="teacher-spec">${t.spec}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function scrollCarousel(dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
    track.scrollBy({ left: dir * 260, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  /* ── RENDER FAQ ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildFaq() {
    const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
    list.innerHTML = faqs.map((f, i) => `
      <div class="faq-item" id="faq-${i}">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(${i})" role="button" tabindex="0" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' ')toggleFaq(${i})">
          <h3>${f.q}</h3>
          <span class="faq-chevron">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="faq-a" id="faq-a-${i}">
          <div class="faq-a-inner">${f.a}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function toggleFaq(idx) {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      if (i === idx) {
        item.classList.toggle('open');
      } else {
        item.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── MODAL ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function openModal(type) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
    const googleBtn = document.getElementById('googleBtn');
    const title = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
    const sub = document.getElementById('modalSub');

    if (type === 'google') {
      title.textContent = 'Continue with Google';
      sub.textContent = 'We\'ll open Google sign-in to create your account.';
      googleBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal(); showToast('✓ Google OAuth would initiate here'); };
    } else {
      title.textContent = 'Start your free trial';
      sub.textContent = 'Get 7 days free. No credit card required.';
      googleBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal(); showToast('✓ Google OAuth would initiate here'); };
    }

    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    if (type === 'email') {
      setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('emailInput').focus(), 350);
    }
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function handleOverlayClick(e) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal();
  }

  function handleFormSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value;
    closeModal();
    showToast(`✓ Welcome! Check ${email} for your sign-in link`);
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
  });

  /* ── TOAST ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
  }

  /* ── INIT ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  buildTabs();
  renderCourses();
  buildTeachers();
  buildFaq();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
